description: Adapts a team workout with AI for a member's level, goals, limits or equipment, as an unsaved draft. Use when the user wants a variant of an existing workout for someone, e.g. a knee-friendly or beginner version. Not for a plain copy (use duplicate_content) or a new workout from scratch (use generate_workout). Returns the draft's steps in build_workout format and the reasons for each change; save it with build_workout.

age.description: Member's age, 16 to 99, e.g. 34. Omit if unknown.

exclude_exercise_collections.description: Never use exercises from these library collections, by name, e.g. ["Free - Eclectic Home"]. Not with include_exercise_collections.

exercise_sources.description: Where swapped-in exercises may come from, at least one: premium_stock = premium library; free_stock = free library; team_exercises = the team's own videos. E.g. ["team_exercises","premium_stock"].

fitness_levels.description: Member's fitness levels, first is primary, e.g. ["intermediate"]. Values: beginner, intermediate, advanced.

gender.description: Member's gender: male, female or other. Omit if unknown.

goal_ids.description: Member's goal IDs from list_team_goals. Omit for the original's goals.

guideline_id.description: Guideline ID from list_programming_guidelines (source=mine). Used with guideline_mode=explicit.

guideline_mode.description: Programming guideline to follow: auto = best match; none = no guideline; explicit = the one in guideline_id. Omit for the backend default.

id.description: ID of the team workout to adapt. Get it from list_team_workouts.

include_exercise_collections.description: Only use exercises from these library collections, by name, e.g. ["Premium - Studio"]. Not with exclude_exercise_collections.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

training_days_per_week.description: How many days a week the member trains, 1 to 7.

user_guidance.description: Free-text context, up to 2000 characters: injuries, space, equipment, likes, e.g. "Knee pain, no jumping".

name: create_similar_workout
title: Create a similar workout
